guarantees.claim: When (mux_sel_buf_output != SelSw) OR lc_ctrl_pkg::lc_tx_test_false_strict(lc_escalate_en_i) is false, reg_state_valid is driven to 0 and reg_state_o is driven to all zeros.

When (mux_sel_buf_output == SelSw) AND lc_tx_test_false_strict(lc_escalate_en_i) is true and keymgr_key_en_i is 0, reg_state_o equals keccak_state_i and reg_state_valid equals keccak_state_valid_i without any zeroing.

When bypass condition true and keymgr_key_en_i is 1, for each share i (0 to Share-1): if reg_keccak_strength_i matches L128, L224, L256, L384, or L512, the top‑most KeccakBitCapacity[strength] bits of reg_state_o[i] are zeroed; in the default case the entire reg_state_o[i] word is zeroed.

assumptions.claim: When keymgr_key_en_i is 1, the bit-range zeroing relies on sha3_pkg::KeccakBitCapacity values being correct and the part‑select [StateW-1-:KeccakBitCapacity[...]] exactly selecting the capacity bits.
assumptions.risk: An off‑by‑one or wrong KeccakBitCapacity could expose secret capacity bits to software.

assumptions.claim: When mux_sel_buf_output == SelSw, the lifecycle signal lc_escalate_en_i must be strictly false (passed by lc_tx_test_false_strict); this test is a precondition for enabling the state output.
assumptions.risk: If lc_escalate_en_i is not strictly false, the block forces reg_state_o to zero, hiding all state regardless of keymgr_key_en_i.

assumptions.claim: When keymgr_key_en_i is 1, parameter Share must be > 0; if Share is 0 the zeroing loop does not execute and capacity is not masked.
assumptions.risk: A Share of 0 would leave keccak_state_i unchanged, potentially exposing capacity.

uncertain_points.claim: The unique case for reg_keccak_strength_i only explicitly handles L128..L512. Any legal strength value outside this set falls into the default branch, which zeroes the entire state word per share instead of just the capacity.
uncertain_points.cond: reg_keccak_strength_i is a legal strength not equal to L128, L224, L256, L384, or L512
uncertain_points.risk: If a new valid strength is introduced and not added to the case, the state output is fully zeroed when keymgr_key_en_i is high, causing functional data loss.
